Par Instagram har username ko line by line check nahi karta! Warna do sau crore users ek-ek karke... bahut zyada time lag jaata!

Toh karta kya hai? Backend mein sabhi usernames, ek HashMap jaisi table mein pehle se rakhe hote hain. Har naam ka ek hash nikalta hai: rahul ka hash saat, rohit ka hash do, priya ka hash chaar... aur har naam apne hash wale bucket mein baith jaata hai.
Ab naya user aaya, aur usne type kiya: rahul. Instagram usi waqt, run time pe, rahul ka hash nikaalta hai... saat! Seedha bucket saat check kiya... rahul pehle se present hai! Toh, already taken!
Aur agar type kiya, rahul twenty six? Hash aaya paanch. Bucket paanch khaali hai... toh username available!
